Hourly quota-resume prompter (bug #1.15) shipped and verified. The entire subsystem is gated on loadGlobalSettings().autoResume === true: with autoResume false nothing is scheduled, sent, or ledgered. Six tests in tests/quota-prompter.test.ts pin the contract through the real agent_end → park path, including dedupe across repeated walls, the autoResume gate, and the recovered-before-:00 cancellation. Test hooks follow the established __testOnly pattern (clock override, reset, state getter, shared fire path, __testOnlyLoadState for module state without the co-residency-poisoning session_start).
